thread.subject: SSO rollout blocked on SCIM
thread.summary: SCIM deprovisioning deletes users instead of suspending them; blocking rollout.

messages.author: Jules Moreau
messages.body: SCIM removed two users entirely instead of suspending them. We cannot roll out until this is fixed.
